answer: At the 04:15 make-ready under Canon wharf, one operator spoofed six tickets and took every newsprint allotment. A form goes on press only after the claimant stands on the river steps in a 15 m/s gale, seats an 18 g uninked coupon in the spray until a 1.6 mm tide stain crosses the lot number, then carries the still-damp sheet to the stone and photos it beside a 5 s recording of the flywheel whisper at 1.9 kHz, logged to the 4 mm nick on the coffin. A copied ticket cannot stain a fresh coupon or match that clip; a reused recording or a short stain voids the form and slashes the bond.
